newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Eight rebels killed in combat in northern Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Eight rebels killed in combat in northern Colombia.

text.p: Eight National Liberation Army (ELN) rebels were killed in a fight with troops in Colombia's northern Bolivar province, military officials said on Saturday.
They said the fighting, in which two soldiers, were wounded occurred on Friday near the town of San Pablo in an area long considered an ELN stronghold.
The southern half of Bolivar province has been the site of frequent clashes in recent months between the ELN, the military and right-wing paramilitary groups.
San Pablo itself was the stated destination of a shipment of high-power explosives that partly destroyed a police station in the capital and killed nine officers earlier this week.
The officers were searching a truck suspected of carrying contraband goods, or weapons for guerrillas, when the explosives were detonated either by accident or remote control.
The ELN, founded by radical Roman Catholic priests in 1966, is Colombia's second largest guerrilla group.
